title: The Indispensability of Risk
summary:
This is the memo by Howard Marks, the indispensability of risk. Most other investments involve real sacrifices, though, where the risk of loss is born in
pursuit of gains that are neither immediate nor tangible. Ashley goes on to speak of sacrifice in risk-return terms that are familiar to investors.
